parsed.note_claim: CICC ordered local offices and child safety plans, and Discord is complying.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The CICC earlier said Discord also committed to opening a PH office but later took it back. Discord, however, has also reached out to them separately "to express its willingness to engage with the agency on its existing teen safety measures," per the CICC.
parsed.reason: The page confirms CICC ordered Discord to establish a local office and address child safety, and that Discord is engaging with the agency on its teen safety measures.
